newsitem.title: USA: Roy F. Weston Inc names McCann as COO.
newsitem.headline: Roy F. Weston Inc names McCann as COO.

text.p: Roy F. Weston Inc said that executive vice president of strategic development Patrick McCann has been named chief operating officer.

McCann, 43, succeeds Peter Marks, who resigned last month along with William Marrazzo, the company's president and chief executive. As previously announced, Marazzo was replaced by acting chief executive and president William Robertson.
McCann joined Weston in October, prior to which he served as president of Advanced Environmental Technical Services, a Chemical Waste Management and AETC Inc joint venture.
Roy F. Weston Inc is an international environmental services firm.
